label: Late original-phase / <DEL> step, boosted by tokens like v,i,w,s,b,t,m,p,3
explanation: Fires during the input phase from step 2 onward and at the <DEL> step. 78% of delimiter steps are active, and <DEL> carries 36% of the mass and all of the top activations. It is essentially silent at steps 0-1 and during the copy phase (598 of 2.7M copy steps). Within the input phase it is more likely to fire at later positions (rate rises from 0.22 at t=2 to about 0.69 at t>=6), and it seldom fires on repeated tokens (rate 0.05 when in_first=0). Strength depends on content: it is stronger after tokens such as v, i, w, s, b, t, m, p, 3 and weak or off when the recent inputs are tokens like g, y, x, f, h, r, j. The top examples ramp up step by step over runs of such tokens and peak at <DEL>. Gating on the original phase alone gives F1 0.67 and captures nearly all mass but with precision 0.51. Adding the token-set condition raises F1 to 0.74 (precision 0.62). The token dependence is graded, not a clean set.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: i, v, w, b, t, 3; least: 1, h, n, f) and the input two steps back (most: v, w, b, s, 3, p; least: e, n, f, -); timing cues that raise it most: phase=1, recall_idx=0, t=6.
